        client.Connect(account.Server, 587, SecureSocketOptions.StartTls);

This is a configuration issue where the user is mixing protocols and ports. The solution would be to use the correct IMAP port (typically 143 for STARTTLS or 993 for SSL/TLS) instead of the SMTP port 587. This can be verified through code analysis without needing to build or run the code. The error message and server response provide enough information to diagnose the issue.
